page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The processor architecture is x86_64, supported by 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across multiple metrics. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1858.69 and a multi-core score of 15508.96. Memory performance is characterized by a read-only small block bandwidth of 848.41 GB/sec and a large block write bandwidth of 56.31 GB/sec. Cryptographic and vector instruction sets such as AVX-512 and AES are present, contributing to a PassMark CPU encryption score of 14601.85 and a database operations score of 7860.64. Redis SET operations reach 15.47 million operations per second, while static web serving throughput is measured at 20.58 GB/sec.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.g7nex.4xlarge offers a balanced hardware profile suitable for general-purpose workloads. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing capabilities without resource stealing, though the lack of local NVMe storage requires external block storage configuration. This instance is well-suited for applications such as database hosting, web serving, and general-purpose enterprise applications that require a steady balance of compute and memory resources without specialized GPU acceleration.
